content: For the customer with the largest outstanding reserve on a single open claim, which policies do they hold?

name: query_salesforce
query_salesforce

content:
The customer is [Copperfield Property Management](/lightning/r/001aj000040t1o5AAA/view). Their claim [00002043](/lightning/r/500aj00003jKc9XAAS/view) has **$490,000** in outstanding reserve, the most on any single open claim. They hold three policies. All are active and expire on 7 Jan 2027:

| Policy | Line | Annual Premium |
|---|---|---|
| [ANT-CP-205061](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKc7pAAC/view) | Commercial Property | $118,000 |
| [ANT-GL-205078](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKc7qAAC/view) | General Liability | $31,200 |
| [ANT-UM-205095](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKc7rAAC/view) | Umbrella | $12,400 |

That's **$161,600** in total annual premium.
